notes: Identity independently checked: supplied cache text identifies Facial appearance affects science communication, Ana I Gheorghiu, Mitchell J Callan, William J Skylark, PNAS 114(23):5970–5975, DOI 10.1073/pnas.1620542114, matching the assigned original reference. This is a primary empirical article parsed from PMC, with main article narrative, methods, references and figure captions; figure graphics and the linked SI Appendix are not included in the supplied text. No PDF was supplied. Study 6 is identifiable, but the generic description spans multiple studies/outcomes and does not distinguish competence, attractiveness, competence × attractiveness, or participant-related coefficients in the study 6 mixed-effects model. Printed candidate evidence is qualitative: positive competence effect, very weak negative attractiveness effect, no competence × attractiveness interaction. Fig. 3 describes regression coefficients with 95% Wald CIs, but the supplied canonical text contains no numeric Study 6 coefficient or exact p value/bound, and no printed d for that test is available in the inspected main-text results. This does not establish absence from the figure graphics or SI Appendix. Candidate study-level N is 824; recognized trials were excluded. No arithmetic or N derivation performed, no N inferred from df, and study N was not promoted to analytic N. All assigned values remain null for unresolved test correspondence and evidence limitations. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders only.
